causal_scope.CONFIRMED: Same live-parent upper-parameter intervention changes total original-chain outcome; exact guard computation sensitivity separately replayed.
causal_scope.SUPPORTED: Guard mediation when crossed stencil/correction/receipt impulse and native motion differ together, especially with unchanged durations and small prior differences.
causal_scope.NOT_TESTED: Direct physical intervention replacing only guard curvature, broad failure rates, safety-equivalent replacement.

negative_control_definition: No crossed centered model stencil at control samples; the continuous trajectory may still change endpoint branch between 5ms samples.
